items.title: Pete Levin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: The duos with Elvin Jones and, wow.

ctx.x: Right. He was only what in his 30s or something?
Something like that. But he was just doing such incredible stuff. The duos with Elvin Jones and, wow.
How did you get into the arranging, the composing, the writing of themes for people and all that? How do you make those contacts?
